parameters: And it is ours to use as we see fit.\! It will take some time to refit it for battle, but with it, we can airdrop troops deep behind enemy lines.
I've never seen one with my own eyes.
Most haven't...\| We haven't flown these things for a hundred years.\! One would have to be wealthy beyond imagination to own one.
I have to admit something to you.
I am afraid of you outgrowing me.\! Outgrowing our cause.
...I do have a history of changing loyalties.
It's not that.\! I don't need loyalty from others.\! Not to me, anyway.
It seems to me that you've become the icon of hope in the peoples' eyes.\! As you are the icon, I would best serve the people as your right hand, if you will have me as such.
That's a relief.\! We'll build a new world together, Lysander.
